items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Yeah. Yeah, Peele was in the band when I got there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, Peele was in the band when I got there. Yeah. But he had a better clarinet player than Peele though, but I can't figure who he was, no. He had several of them.
He had Willard Toomey at one time, did you know him?
